name: PluginEvalCaseContext
description:
PluginEvalCaseContext is what one plugin-eval case gives its try beyond
 the prompt: a starting folder, reference folders, an earlier
 conversation, variables, and stand-ins for the plugin's MCP servers.

fields.name: PluginId
fields.description: ID of the plugin whose case this is.

fields.name: PluginDigest
fields.description: The plugin version (archive digest) the eval runs.

fields.name: ScaffoldScript
fields.description: The Bash script that builds the starting folder; empty for none.

fields.name: AddDirs
fields.description: Directories the agent may read during the run.

fields.name: HistoryFile
fields.description: A Claude Code transcript (.jsonl) the try resumes; empty for none.

fields.name: Env
fields.description: EVAL_* variables the agent's shell and the plugin's hooks receive.

fields.name: Mocks
fields.description: The plugin's MCP servers answered by stand-ins, one per server.

fields.name: AgentMockModel
fields.description: The model agent stand-ins answer with; empty uses the runner's default.

fields.name: AgentMockCallBudget
fields.description: Calls the agent stand-ins may answer in this try, together.

fields.name: ReadFiles
fields.description:
The files the case's graders read, relative to the workspace. The
 runner returns their contents after the turn in
 RunStatus.plugin_eval_files, so a grader can read a file the try did not
 change (one the scaffold wrote, for example).

fields.name: PluginName
fields.description:
The plugin's name, as a turn names its MCP servers
 (`plugin_<plugin>_<server>`) and a hook reads a stand-in's origin.
